summary.title: LAUVØYA MARINA AS

narrative.text: LAUVØYA MARINA AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Andre tjenester tilknyttet sjøtransport", registered 2016-06-14.
Registered activity: Utleie av båtplasser, utbygging og utleie av eiendom i maritime miljø. Videre annen virksomhet som er innenfor det maritime område.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 1.4 million and an annual result of NOK -315,143.
Registered leadership: Bjørge Ramfjord (Daglig leder); Bjørge Ramfjord (Styrets leder).
Head office in Rørvik, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
